scientific_integrity: The final research claim is the exact all-wheel fractional minimal-fort transversal and packing gap. The pre-existing complete wheel minimal-fort polynomial is cited as earlier research, not a novel contribution. Fractional optimization is justified for every n by rotational averaging and two tight structural fort classes; finite enumeration corroborates only small instances. No claim of external certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary wheel K_1 join C_n with n>=3 is treated.
Z* is the fort-hypergraph LP relaxation, not a different zero-forcing game.
The full wheel minimal-fort polynomial and its rational generating function were proved in a 2026-11-02 earlier result and are not claimed as new.
An unindexed prior all-wheel fractional computation remains a possible historical-priority risk.
title: Exact fort-transversal relaxation and packing gap on wheel graphs
